Commentary.Commentary: So, Afghanistan make a strong statement by beating a team like Sri Lanka. Their impressive rise in international cricket is such an inspirational story. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, need to dig in deep, identify and rectify their mistakes that they are repeating. They need to find some inspiration from their past victories and achievements of their former heroes. Next up, on Tuesday we are all set to witness India taking on Hong Kong in their first game of the tournament. The defending champions, without their regular captain Virat Kohli, will be keen to perform well and prove that they are not a one-man army. Hong Kong, on the other hand, will look to come up with a contest and give a hard time to the Men in Blue. We eagerly await the exciting contest to start at 1530 local (1130 GMT). Till then take care, goodbye, stay healthy and most importantly, have fun. Until next time, it's adios from our side.

Man of the Match, Rahmat Shah firstly thanks the Almighty. Says that the wicket was good which helped him bat well. Adds that he was waiting for the loose balls. Ends by saying that it was an important match and he is happy to earn this award.

Afghanistan skipper, Asghar Afghan says that it was a very important game because Sri Lanka are a good team. Credits his batters and openers for giving them a good start. Adds that his players executed their plans well and gives credit to his fielders too. On their recent success, he replies that they are a good team and want to play positive cricket. On being asked if they can win the Asia Cup, he suggests that if they bat well and set a good target, they have the spinners to defend it. Ends by thanking the crowd for their support.

Sri Lanka skipper, Angelo Mathews is shocked by the performance of the whole team. Stresses on their batting failures and is really disappointed. Congratulates Afghanistan for outplaying them. He is happy with the bowlers and fielders but is gutted with the overall result. Ends by saying that they repeated the same mistakes again and couldn't handle pressure.

Once Sri Lanka came out to chase a target of 250, they needed good application and smart cricket but that is exactly what the Lankans could not manage. Afghanistan bowled and fielded with great intensity and always had a firm grip on the game. Losing two matches in a row, first to Bangladesh and then to Afghanistan will be a big shock for the Lankans and they truly have nothing going their way.

Earlier in the day, we saw a mature batting effort from Afghanistan. They showed tremendous application and a strong desire to fight it out and put up a competitive total on the board. Their top order laid the platform and in spite of an ordinary end, they managed to post a challenging total on the board. Thisara Perera bagging a fifer was one of the highlights of the Lankan bowling efforts. With the Sri Lankan batsmen going through a lean patch and the Afghans possessing quality in their bowling, we surely did expect a contest but never expected it to be so one-sided in favour of the latest country to get Test status.

The Sri Lankan chase started on a disastrous note as they lost their first wicket in the form of Kusal Mendis on the very second ball of their innings. That set the ball rolling for Afghanistan as they just did not allow the Sri Lankan batters to take any kind of control on the game. A 54-run second wicket partnership between Upul Tharanga and Dhananjaya de Silva must have given their fans some hope of a fighting chase but the untimely run out of Dhananjaya de Silva forced the Lankans back and they never got going from there. The spin trio of Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Mohammad Nabi and Rashid Khan were just too good for the Lankans today as they kept on taking wickets at regular intervals.

Sri Lanka are knocked out! A dream start to the tournament for the minnows and a shocking defeat for the 5-time champions. This will jolt them badly. A 91-run defeat is a thrashing and it will take a lot of determination and effort on their part to overcome this loss and bounce back in their future games. Afghanistan's bowling was second to none. All their bowlers except for Aftab Alam managed to take two wickets each. Their fielding was also top notch and we witnessed a couple of run outs as well.

OUT! As plumb as it can get! The middle of middle stump is where the ball would have smashed into, as per the Hawk Eye. Rashid Khan unveils his magic as he fires this very full in the line of the stumps. Malinga tries to sweep across the line towards the mid-wicket area. But the Sri Lankan pacer gets beaten in flight and pace. The ball sneaks under his bat and raps him on the pads. They appeal and the finger has gone up. The Sri Lankan innings has capitulated here and the ever-impressive Afghanistan start their 2018 Asia Cup campaign with a thumping 91-run win.
Chameera gets behind this delivery on off and dabs it to the off side for a run.
A length ball around off is taped into the point region for a single.
Banged in again by Naib and a similar response there from Chameera.
Bumper time. Naib trying to intimidate the batsman but Chameera has nothing doing as he ducks under that one easily.
Variation in length. Some chin music for the new batsman, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.

OUT! The death rattle! Naib delivers the knockout blow in all likelihood. He takes out Perera with a slower length ball around off, angling in from around the wicket. Perera tries to deposit the ball into the mid-wicket stand but he completely loses his shape and balance. The ball goes under his bat and crashes into the wooden sticks behind. Just the lone wicket remaining now. Can Afghanistan finish this off quickly?
Naib dishes this out a bit wide of off. Perera tries to reach at it but misses as the ball is collected by Shahzad behind.
Gulbadin Naib comes back into the attack.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be positioned outside the 30-yard circle.
A full ball is driven through covers for a single.
The batsman waits for the ball to arrive and guides it towards the third man region with an open bat face. One run added to the total.
Malinga looking to hit this one through the off side gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads. No run.
A fuller length ball is driven confidently towards mid on and the batsmen cross over for a quick single. Every run counts.
Perera  has punched the ball off the back foot.
Khan bowls this flatter and attacking the stumps. Perera quickly goes back an punches it into the cover-point region but no run on offer.
Malinga has played it to the point region to end the over.

Nabi getting all his experience into play here. He is keeping it very tight around off and is constantly changing the pace of each of his deliveries so that the batsman cannot line him up. Malinga patiently defends.
A slower ball around off is blocked out off the back foot.
A flighted ball on and around off is defended off the front foot.
Lasith Malinga walks out to the middle.

OUT! That's the class of Nabi. He is definitely a world class bowler with his accuracy and his change in pace almost each ball. He flights this one as well and keeps it on off. Dananjaya goes for the wild slog across the line and completely misses the ball as he is seen losing his balance also. The ball makes contact with the stumps and it's a very ugly dismissal. Afghanistan inching closer.
Tossed up ball around off. Pushed back to the bowler.
Floated and on middle, it's forced down to long off for a run. Another tidy over, Sri Lanka going nowhere at the moment.
Once again the bowler is on the shorter side, Perera punches it to sweeper for one.
Fails to work it on the leg side and it goes off his pads to short fine leg. They cross for a leg bye as the fielder scores a direct hit at the striker's end. No harm done.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shorter in length this time, Perera camps back and slaps it to sweeper cover for one.
Skidding back into the batsman, Perera blocks it back at the last second.
Rocks back to a shortish delivery and punches it down to long on for one.
Plays it late, uses the angle of the bowler and steers it wide of short third man for a brace.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it back towards the bowler.
Skidding down, Dananjaya fails to flick and it goes off his pads to the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Dananjaya has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Dananjaya showing his batting prowess as he beautifully drives a full length ball through covers to get a run.
A full length ball is flicked into the mid-wicket region.

Dananjaya is beaten on the very first ball he plays. He looks to play for the spin into him but the ball pitches and turns away beating the outside edge. Akila survives and that is the most important fact.
Akila Dananjaya is the new batsman in. Can he be the hero with the bat for a change and take his side across the finish line?

OUT! Mujeeb strikes to send Shanaka back who can be a dangerous batsman. Afghanistan will be more than happy. The bowler keeps it a bit shorter around off stump. Shanaka, thinking it is a leg spinner, goes on the back foot to punch it hard through the off side. But for his shock and to Afghanistan's delight, the ball lands and comes into Shanaka. This means that the batsman is completely bamboozled which results in the ball cutting into him and crashing into the timber behind.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A fuller ball is flicked into the leg side for a single.
Dasun Shanaka is the new man in. Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes back into the attack.

OUT! Mathews holes out and that's a body blow to Sri Lanka. A smart bowling change by the skipper. Nabi has done the trick. He tosses it up in the air and lands it full around middle. Angelo runs down the track with the intention to clear the long on fence. But he fails to gather enough distance on this one and is caught with ease by Rashid Khan in the deep. It's going from bad to worse for Sri Lanka, 107 needed off 90 balls.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
A slower shorter of a good length ball is punched comfortably to the cover region.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Mathews works it through square leg and collects a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to sweeper cover for a run.
Mohammad Nabi comes into the attack. How valuable will his experience be in such a tight situation?
Mathews rocks back to this shorter of a length ball on off and punches it to the cover region. A dot ball to finish the over. 110 required off 16 overs.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Flatter and quicker angling into the batsman. Flicked towards the square leg region for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! This time on the legs of the left-hander. Thisara, against his natural style of play, delicately gets some bat on this quicker ball. The speed on the ball is enough to take it across the fine leg boundary.
Leg bye! Rashid starts with one which strays down the leg. Mathews looks to nudge it down the leg side but misses. The ball hits his pads and rolls towards the vacant square leg region for a single.

That's Drinks. Sri Lanka are on the back foot and the current pair is trying to revive their fortunes. Mathews is the key for Sri Lanka as they require another 116 runs in 17 overs. They need to get moving now. On the other hand, Afghanistan cannot afford to relax at this moment after doing all the good work. An intense passage of play awaits us post the break. Stay tuned...
Knocks a full ball down through mid on for a run. 9 from the over.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. They pick up a single.
Yorker on middle, dug out to square leg for another single.
Straighter in line, worked in the gap on the leg side for one.

FOUR! Eased away! Short in length around middle and leg. The around the wicket angle takes it down and Perera just helps it with a pull shot past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. The bowler now wants that fielder to be sent in the deep.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground. They pick up a single and are on track in building a steady stand which is currently on 26.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Perera looks to get behind this one to defend but pushes at it a bit earlier which results in him getting a leading edge. The ball is deflected to the off side.
A fuller length ball angling into the batsman is driven through mid on and they take a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Very full around off, Perera flicks it away with a wristy shot but again for nothing.
The batsman works it down the leg side but no run on offer as it goes straight to the fielder at square leg.
Rashid Khan into the attack. Can the world class competitor seal it for his team and contribute in a memorable win this evening? Interesting times ahead for sure...
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

FOUR! That is all class! The attitude, the body language and the confidence being displayed by Mathews is simply breathtaking. Aftab fires in a very full delivery on middle and leg. Almost a yorker this but Mathews from within his crease just nonchalantly flicks it with utmost disdain. The ball is seen skimming across the outfield and crossing the deep mid-wicket boundary. Mathews putting up a fight in this do-or-die game for his team.
A very full delivery is driven through mid on for a single.

A bit shorter than good length and continues to keep it around off. Seeing the ball a bit short, Mathews quickly rocks back and punches the ball into the cover-point region to add another run to the total.
The Lankan skipper plays that off the front foot and into the ground.
A full and straight ball is flicked into the square leg region for a single to start the over.
Rocks back and eases this ball through mid off for a run. Just the three runs off the over. Sri Lanka need to keep their cool and take the game deeper.
Comes across the stumps and hits it in the gap through mid on. One run added to the total.
Mathews has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quicker one in line of the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Off spinner outside off again, hit to mid off.
Off spinner on off, Perera pushes this through cover-point to give his skipper the strike.
The batsman works it down the leg side to the man at mid-wicket.
Digs this one short again. Perera pulls it along the turf through square leg for a single.
Straighter one around off, milked through mid on for an easy run.
Short ball outside off, Mathews punches the ball off his back foot.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Outside off, Mathews plays it towards backward point.
Gulbadin Naib in for another spell.
Off spinner around off, worked around the corner for one.
On middle and leg, played with a straight bat to long on for a easy run.
Full and in line of the stumps, hit back to the bowler.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Thisara Perera joins his skipper.

OUT! Another confusion, another run out and another wicket gifted to the ever so delighted Afghans. Mujeeb from around the wicket tosses this full ball at the legs of the batsman. Shehan leans across and flicks it into the deep mid-wicket region. The batsmen have taken the first run quickly with the intention to come back for a brace. Not sure about Mathews but his left-handed partner definitely wanted to get back on strike. The Lankan skipper after turning has his hand raised to send his partner back who is very late in getting that signal. In the meantime, the fielder in the deep collects the ball and fires in a flat one-bounce throw right on top of the stumps at the bowler's end. Mujeeb has some simple work to do and he completes the formality by whipping off the bails in sheer joy. Shehan is well short of the crease. Mathews is seen letting out his frustration as the southpaw starts to walk back slowly and utterly disappointed. 142 more required from 137 balls.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman returns in the attack.
The ball has taken the inside edge of the bat and goes down the leg side. They pick up another run to end the over.
Strays on the leg side again. It's flicked away off his pads for a run.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Finds the gap. Flicked away through square leg to get off strike.
Darted once again on the legs, flicked to the man at square leg.
Full on the legs, worked to the leg side.
Jayasuriya defends it from within the crease. Afghanistan keep applying the pressure.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second.
Bowls this down leg, Mathews works it down the leg side for one.
SJ works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Long long appeal but nothing from the umpire. Afghanistan have no review left. Fuller leg spinner around off, Jayasuriya looks to sweep this but cannot get bat to ball. Is struck on his pads. Rashid is up in appeal but the umpire does not move. Perhaps missing the stumps.
Picks up the leg spinner and drives this through covers. The batsmen come back for an easy two.
Another full ball on off, hit to the off side.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Goes onto his back foot and hits this through covers again. One more run taken.
Goes back and punches the ball to the cover-point region.
Uses the crease and punches the ball through covers. They pick up a single.
Flat and on the pads. Mathews hits it to the man at mid on.
Mohammad Nabi is into the attack.
Change in bowling.
Another good over from Rashid. Darts this around middle and leg. Shehan hits it to the on side.
Jayasuriya rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Rashid is giving no room to the batsman to work with. Angles this into the middle and leg line, Shehan turns it on the leg side but straight to the fielder.
This is quite close to the off pole. Jayasuriya guides it late but some good work by the fielder in the slip region certainly saves some runs.
Quicker ball around off, Mathews drives it past the mid off fielder for a run.
Goes back and punches this through cover-point to get to the other end.
Full and outside off, driven to covers. Dot ball.
Jayasuriya guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
On the pads again, Mathews works it to the leg side for one more.
Straying in the line and gets an easy run. Full and down the leg side. Shehan helps it on it's way to the fine leg boundary for one.
Outside off again, cut to the man at point.
Short ball outside off, pulled away to the leg side.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.

A crowd catch. The Afghan players appeal but the umpire is firm in his decision. Yorker around off, Jayasuriya hits it on the ground and Rashid moves to his left to collect it. Stifled appeal which died down.
Almost! Quicker ball around off, the ball spins back into Jayasuriya. Gets just enough bat and the ball thuds into his pads.
SJ shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and on off, dug out to the off side through covers for one.
Leg spinner around off, driven towards mid off to get off strike.
Stands inside his crease and taps this ball in front of him.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Jayasuriya throwing his bat at everything. Another fuller ball outside off, Shehan goes hard at it and hits it to mid off.
Full outside off, Shehan gets behind the ball and drives it to mid off.
Shehan Jayasuriya is the new man in.

OUT! Sri Lanka are losing their way in this run chase and are digging a deep hole for themselves. Another poor shot selection from the batsman causes his downfall. Fuller ball outside off again. Tharanga does not get under the ball enough and hits it straight to Asghar at mid off who takes it with glee. The well-set batsman has to walk back and Sri Lanka are in a big trouble. He probably wanted to go over the infield but failed to achieve the desired elevation. They need 162 runs in 178 balls.
Yorker around off. Tharanga gets his bat down in time.
Gulbadin Naib is back into the attack.
Nervy beginning for Mathews. He tries to push it through the off side but it takes an inside edge and rolls through square leg for a couple of runs. Excellent beginning from the star bowler.
The Sri Lankan skipper and their best batsman, Angelo Mathews comes out to bat.

OUT! Oh, bowled him! Rashid, you beauty. Perera wanted to dominate the leggie but instead got dominated. A looped up ball landing on middle, Kusal attempts a wild slog sweep over the leg side but fails to read the length properly. It goes under his bat and disturbs the stumps. Khan is delighted, this is a big breakthrough for Afghanistan. They continue to maintain a strong hold on this game.

Tharanga looks set and he should be the one who will anchor the Sri Lanka innings if they want to have a chance of reaching this target. Khan keeps it full in length around off stump line. Upul drives this crisp and clean to mid off and the batsmen cross for another single.
A flighted full pitch delivery is driven to mid off for a quick single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

This length ball around off, with a slight inward shape hits the batsman low on the pads as he tries to flick it but misses. The ball hits his pads and rolls towards the square leg region to allow the batsmen to cross over for a leg bye.
A flighted and full length ball is driven calmly towards mid on.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Perera knows how to use the broom. Nabi tosses this one on the stumps, Perera premeditates as he is seen going down at the same time when Nabi delivers the ball. He kneels, goes for the sweep and pretty much nails it. The ball races across the outfield and into the deep square leg fence.
Perera turns this straighter ball into the leg side.
Tossed up on off, the batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. One run added to the total.
A fuller length ball is  driven through mid on by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.

FOUR! Streaky but welcome! When you take risks, take it with all your might. Alam bangs this one short, with an intention of surprising the batsman with a change in length but Perera is up to it as he responds with an attacking instinct and plays the pull shot. The ball bounces a bit more than he expected and that results in a top edge which sails over the top of the keeper's head. A boundary results. Sri Lanka will take them whichever way they come.
Tossed up around off, is blocked out off the front foot.
Quicker and straighter on the stumps, Perera works it down the leg side but no run on offer there.
The Sri Lanka opener has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Alam starts his spell with an ill-directed ball going down leg. Perera works it down the leg side and picks up a single.
Aftab Alam comes into the attack. Can he deliver for his side with some quick wickets? Interesting phase of play coming up...

Missing leg, the inward drift on the nut has, ironically, saved the batsman and has gone against the bowler this time. How funny is this game? That's exactly why we like it so much. Nabi fires this one in line with the stumps and angling into Tharanga. Upul tries to flick it onto the leg side but it seems as though he gets and inside edge onto his pads. But Afghanistan appeal loud and think that they can overturn this decision. Time for the replay to roll in. No bat involved and then Hawk Eye shows that the ball is missing the leg stump by quite a margin. Afghanistan have lost their review and Upul survives.

Review time as Sri Lanka go for it. The batsman in question is Upul Tharanga who has been given not out by the umpire and the Afghanistan team has challenged that decision. However, it seems that they have gone for it in more of a hope rather than conviction. Let's see now...
The batsman dances down the track but decides to defend it. Good control shown by Upul as he aborts from the shot at the last moment when he understands that he has not got to the pitch of it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower and shorter around off, the batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They cross for a single.
Quicker one, full and on off, pushed towards covers for a sharp run again.
Bowls it with a round-arm action and darts in a shortish ball on off. Kusal goes back and hits it in front of square on the off side. They cross for a confusing single.
A length ball, too straight in line, it's clipped fine down the leg side for a run.
Good length ball outside off, Tharanga punches it with good timing to covers. Straight to the fielder who misfields and concedes a run.
Beaten again! This time the length is a bit short outside off. Tharanga stays back to cut but misses. He's disappointed with himself. Two dot balls after a boundary.
Play and a miss! Needs to be careful, Tharanga. He tries to use the pace of the bowler and run it down to third man but misses.
FOUR! What a shot! A length ball in the region outside off, Tharanga takes a stride forward and drills his drive through extra cover for a cracking boundary.
Yorker delivered in the blockhole, Tharanga digs it out safely.
Tossed up ball on off, Perera is forward in defense.
Once again Upul shows good footwork as he eases it down to long on for one.
Floated and on off, defended solidly.
Uses his feet this time and strokes his drive through covers. Rashid in the deep makes a quick stop but cannot prevent the second run.

Appeal for an lbw! Not given. This one straightens a touch from around off. Tharanga tries to flick but probably his bat gets stuck on his pad. He misses and is rapped on the pads. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. Height factor?
Flighted and full on off, it's driven off the front foot to short cover.
Tossed up slower and a bit wide of off. The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and driven to covers. Tight bowling this.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.

OUT! Comedy of errors on display here. A scene to remember for a long time. Naib keeps this slower one outside off. De Silva pushes at a wide length ball and gets an outside edge towards the third man region. There is some miscommunication between the batting pair during the second run they try. The confusion is so strong that Dhananjaya almost ends up being at the same end as Tharanga, who is very late in responding as he was ball-watching. The throw comes to Shahzad who collects it and breaks the stumps before releasing it towards the bowler's end. Naib gets hurried up a bit and makes a complete mess by running across and falling straight on top of the stumps before he can get his hands on the ball. It's referred upstairs, the replays roll in and they show that Shahzad was very smart to first disturb the stumps at his end before throwing it towards Naib. It has done the trick as Dhananjaya is found inches short of the crease. Miscommunication, confusion, panic and disaster, that's the outline of this story. This will go down as one of the most bizarre moments in cricket. Total chaos! An interesting observation by Sangakkara. He points out that Dhananjaya stuttered just a bit when Tharanga finally decided to see him charging in and that moment probably cost him.
Kusal Perera is the new man for Sri Lanka.
The umpires have gone upstairs for a run out appeal. Is there a wicket for Afghanistan? If yes, who has got out? Very confusing on the field and in my machine as well.
Tharanga turns this into the leg side but straight to the man at short fine leg and hence no run on offer there.
A full length delivery is driven and driven crisply to covers but straight to the fielder.
Upul has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot but missed.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
De Silva works it down the leg side to pick up a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Four bonus runs! Gift presented and Sri Lanka will happily accept. Nabi starts the over with a quicker delivery from around the wicket and angling into the batsman. The drift on it takes the ball down the leg side and Shahzad behind cannot stop it.
Fuller on off, driven to covers.
Naib flights this a bit more outside off. De Silva looking to play at it misses as he plays the wrong line.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

That is authoritative to the core from de Silva. Naib keeps this slower one full around off. De Silva skips down the track and smashes it straight over the umpire and the ball races across the straight boundary. Cracking shot this, a confidence building one.
A shortish delivery is pulled into the mid-wicket region. The timing was lacking and hence no run results.
Nice tight line and length  by Naib. The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
De Silva has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A slider beats the bat. Nabi bringing his skills into play as he keeps it full around off. De Silva plays for the non-existent spin and is beaten.
Flatter and fired into the batsman from around the wicket. Flicked into the square leg region for a single.
Tossed up full around off, driven crisply by Tharanga but straight to the cover fielder.
Mohammad Nabi comes into the attack. Can the experienced campaigner deliver for his team? Let's see..
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Now 4 players will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle until the 40th over.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tries to do the same thing as 9.3 but cannot get the same timing. The ball goes high over the cover region. Asghar hares towards it but it falls well ahead of him. Two runs added to the total.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SIX! Shot of the day! Glorious! Full and around off, de Silva extends his arms and lets the ball sail over the extra cover region. Holds his pose for the photographers to capture it.

Direct hit and Tharanga would have been a gonner. Plays this with soft hands towards mid on. Rashid there, dives and has a shy at the non-striker's end. Tharanga also dives but would have been still short. Rashid seems to have hurt his bowling arm while putting the dive. The replays show that he landed on it as he went down. Luckily, he is back on his feet and is looking fine.
Good movement from the medium pacer. Bowls in the correct line and gets the ball to move away from the batsman. Outside off, Tharanga throws his bat at it but can't make any contact.
Gulbadin Naib is the first bowling change.
Can't find the gap this time. Driven straight to the man at mid on.
Milked through mid on for an easy run.
UT has flicked the ball off his pads but straight to mid-wicket.

FOUR! That's his strength. Makes full use of the crease and times the ball perfectly. Short ball from Rahman on middle and leg. Upul rocks back and cuts it through point. The ball races to the boundary.
On the legs of Tharanga who flicks it towards the square leg fielder to collect.
Outside off, cut to point.
Fuller this time outside off, driven to covers. Good over from Aftab. Tidy stuff.
Rocks back and punches the ball to the off side.
Stays inside and taps it in front of him.
Dhananjaya defends it from within the crease.
Played to the point region. They cross.
Stays on the back foot and taps it down to backward point.
Strays on the pads again. Tharanga helps it on its way towards the fine leg boundary. They come back for the third run.

Long appeal but nothing from the umpire. Pitches it outside leg and hits Upul on his pads who misses his flick. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. They don't opt for the review. Good move as we were shown in the replays that it would have gone above the stumps.
Full on leg, turned to the leg side.
Punched off the backfoot by the batsman. Dot ball.
Two wides. Angles this down the leg side. De Silva still goes after it but it's too far away from him. Shahzad cannot get to the ball quickly they cross.
Driven through the covers by Dhananjaya.
Leg bye! Full and on the leg side. Tharanga gets it off his thigh pad towards short fine leg for a run.
On the pads of de Silva who misses his flick and gets hit on his pads. Slow going as Sri Lanka are trying to recover from the early loss of a wicket.
That ball has taken the inside edge of his batsman and thudded into his pads.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Swing! Good bowling from Alam. Getting the ball to move both ways. Lands this outside off and the ball comes back in sharply. Beats the inside edge of Dhananjaya and Shahzad too fails to collect it. They pick up two byes.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. .
Outside off, de Silva gets it off the bottom of his bat towards third man for an easy couple.

DROPPED? Shahzad has put down a catch behind the wickets. Slower ball outside off. Tharanga looks to play it with a straight bat but gets an inside edge to it. It goes into the hands of the keeper and pops out. Replays later show that it was not a drop catch as the sound was of the bat hitting the pads.
Outside off, Upul looks to drive but gets a fat edge past the slip region. The ball goes towards third man and they take a couple.
Uses his feet well again and hits it in the gap through covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
De Silva has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tharanga flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Gets ahead and drives this ball to the off side.
Stands tall and punches this to the off side.
Back of a length ball around off. The ball nips back in and strikes de Silva outside off on his thigh pad.
Direct hit would have been close. Length outside off, Tharanga taps it towards point and hares to the other end. The fielder stationed there has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Play and miss. Outside off, Tharanga is beaten as he misses the line of the delivery.
Full and on the pads of Upul who flicks it away through square leg for a brace.
Length outside off, Tharanga gets a soft leading edge towards the off side.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

FOUR! Shot! Not afraid to use his feet and gets a boundary to his name. Rahman gives this air outside off. De Silva reads it well, comes down the track and lofts it over covers for a good looking boundary.
Full and on off, hit with the inner half towards mid on for a single.
Gets behind the ball this time and gives it back to the bowler.
Carrom ball! And an inside edge saves Tharanga. Pitches up outside off, it comes back into Upul who gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Off spinner outside off, de Silva punches it off his back foot through covers for one.
Tharanga lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Comes in from over the wicket and lands it around off, Upul goes fishing and is beaten.
Fuller around off, Upul plays it with a straight bat.
FOUR! Misses his line and strays it down the leg side. Tharanga helps it on its way and it goes fine to the fine leg boundary.
Bowls this closer to the stumps, Tharanga feels for it but cannot get bat to ball.
On a good length outside off, Tharanga shoulders his arms to it.
Aftab Alam to bowl from the other end.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. A near perfect start for the fielding side, a wicket maiden to start proceedings. Can't ask for more, can you?
Drags his length back a bit, de Silva defends it off his back foot.
Darts this one full around off. The ball comes in and strikes Dhananjaya low on his pads outside off.
Quicker one on off, de Silva gets low and bunts it down.
Dhananjaya de Silva is in at no. 3.

OUT! What a start for Afghanistan! Not so much for Sri Lanka though. Guess what? Kusal Mendis fails yet again and registers another duck to his name. Tossed up ball outside off. The ball spins in and hits Mendis on his pads who plays the wrong line. Mujeeb appeals and the umpire takes his time in raising the dreaded finger. Mendis does not opt for the review and takes the slow walk back. Good that he did not go for the review as the replays show that the umpire's call would have stood firm.
Comes in from over the wicket and lands it on middle and leg. Mendis plays it to the on side.
We are back for the chase. Upul Tharanga and Kusal Mendis will open for the Men in Blue. Afghanistan have given the ball to Mujeeb Ur Rahman to bowl the first over.
